scripts.dev:https: mkdir -p certificates && ([ -f certificates/localhost.pem ] || openssl req -x509 -newkey rsa:2048 -nodes -sha256 -subj '/CN=localhost' -addext 'subjectAltName=DNS:localhost,IP:127.0.0.1' -keyout certificates/localhost-key.pem -out certificates/localhost.pem -days 365) && next dev --experimental-https --experimental-https-key certificates/localhost-key.pem --experimental-https-cert certificates/localhost.pem -p 3002
